summary: Round 2 of T2-04 passes. All three story checks ran clean. The round-1 blocker (order-dependent float summation of signed powers) is fixed with exact integer block sums, and the new regression and permutation tests cover it. I found no new defects. The only changes are polarimetry.py and test_polarimetry_derive.py, both inside the story's files list.

checks.criterion: AC1: derive_circular(kind, data, convention, mask) returns SC/OC/CPR plus state and reason; unknown kind or undeclared convention raises; F1–F7 through the interface equal stories 2–3
checks.evidence: 141 passed. Tests at test_polarimetry_derive.py:289-526 cover the interface, raising on unknown kind and undeclared convention, and F1–F7 equality.

checks.criterion: AC2: 4x4 hand-computed block; ratio of mean powers and mean of pixelwise ratios are returned under different field names
checks.evidence: Tests at :528-580 (primary statistic, two pixels that differ, full hand-computed 4x4 block). BlockAggregates has separate ratio_of_mean_powers and mean_of_pixelwise_ratios fields (polarimetry.py:2062-2063).

checks.criterion: AC3: missing and invalid pixels are excluded and counted; a zero-valid block has state MISSING or INVALID with a reason and no value; OC<=0 handling is decided and documented
checks.evidence: _support and BlockSupport carry n_valid, n_missing, valid_fraction and per-reason invalid counts; _no_valid_pixels at polarimetry.py:1848. Tests at :581-730 cover the zero-OC pixel and the all-missing, all-invalid and mixed blocks. The aggregate_blocks docstring at :1944-1953 documents the same-support rule.

checks.criterion: AC4: dB-tagged and amplitude input are refused by type; a dB helper exists for display only
checks.evidence: aggregate_blocks raises TypeError for any type other than the two linear-power records (polarimetry.py:1985). Tests at :896-965 cover the dB helper and the refusal of dB, amplitude and bare arrays.

checks.criterion: AC5: block size is an argument and not hard-coded; per-block origin is returned; blocks_independent is False
checks.evidence: block_size is a required keyword (polarimetry.py:1927) and block_origin is returned (:2007). blocks_independent is forced to False (:1734-1740). Tests at :758-840.

checks.criterion: AC6: Hypothesis permutation invariance and scale invariance; round-1 summation fix
checks.evidence: Exact integer sums via _exact_sums (polarimetry.py:1862-1879). The signs of the exact sums drive OC_NONPOSITIVE and SC_NEGATIVE, so decisions cannot flip with pixel order. Tests: parametrized order regressions at :650-700, the signed-power permutation property at :1084 asserting bitwise equality, scaling properties at :1144-1161, and an exact-oracle test at :1199.

checks.criterion: Check: uv run mypy pipeline/src pipeline/tests
checks.evidence: Success: no issues found in 11 source files
ruff check passed, ruff format --check reported 12 files already formatted, mypy reported no issues in 12 source files.
Only polarimetry.py and test_polarimetry_derive.py changed. Neither config/run.yaml nor any data file was touched.

findings.claim: make check runs ruff and mypy only, not pytest, so its pass says nothing about the numerical tests.
findings.evidence: make check output showed only ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy. The pytest run was done separately and passed (141 tests). Informational only.

resolution.reason: Not a defect in this story. make check is the static target (ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy), and make test runs pytest (Makefile check-py and test-py). PRD 12 Commands defines make test as the unit-test command, separate from static checks. The story checks list runs uv run pytest pipeline/tests/test_polarimetry_derive.py as its first command, so the numerical tests are checked on their own. The reviewer confirms 141 passed and calls the note informational. The Makefile is also outside this story's files list. Rerun at resolve time: story pytest 141 passed (exit 0), mypy no issues (exit 0), make check exit 0, make test 883 passed.
